arc_summary: I'm creating a joyful childhood memory montage that bursts with energy from the first frame, using quick cuts to musical onsets to create a lively, playful rhythm. The edit builds through diverse moments of laughter, movement, and interaction, peaking around 27 seconds with the most energetic clips, then resolves into a warm, wholesome final moment that lingers with the text overlay 'Oh, to be this young again.'
